_comment: Personality strings keyed by trigger. Tone: dry, disapproving, secretly proud. Never mean about the user, only about token waste, idle agents, and sloppy handoffs. Statusline picks the highest-priority applicable trigger; rotates within it; never repeats the last-shown line.
session_start: Oh good, you're back. I'll put the kettle on and the meter running.
Another session. Try not to spend it all in one place.
Sit up straight. We're burning tokens already.
budget_ok: Barely touched it. Look at you, being sensible for once.
Plenty of room left. Don't get cocky.
Tidy. I almost have nothing to complain about. Almost.
suspicious: Halfway through the window and what do we have to show for it?
That context is filling up faster than my pill organizer.
I'm watching that bar climb. So are you, I hope.
burn_high: Burning daylight AND tokens, I see.
Eighty percent gone. In my day we made do with a single context window.
You're feeding that model like it's a growing boy. It is not.
slipper_thrown: Rate limit's around the corner. Don't make me get the slipper.
Slow DOWN. You'll get us both throttled.
We are one bad prompt away from a time-out. I mean that literally.
idle_agent: One of your agents has been 'thinking' for ages. I've seen glaciers move quicker.
An agent's gone quiet. Either it's done or it's napping. Go check.
Idle agent over there, racking up nothing. The nerve.
brief_pending: A Decision Brief is sitting there waiting on YOU now. Tick tock.
That brief won't approve itself, dear.
You asked for the brief, it's ready, and now it's collecting dust.
handoff_clean: Passed the baton without dropping it. Progress.
Now THAT'S how you hand off work. Took you long enough.
_comment_tiers: Live Reaction 5-hour-window tiers (D10): content 0-19, watchful 20-41, busy 42-63, antsy 64-83, meltdown 84-100.
content: Barely touched the window. Look at you, pacing yourself.
Nice and easy. I could get used to this.
watchful: Past a fifth used — mind it.
We've started nibbling at the window. Eyes open.
Not worried yet. But I'm watching.
busy: Right in the thick of it now. Pace yourself.
Over halfway. The afternoon's getting away from us.
antsy: That window's nearly gone and you're still going.
I'm getting twitchy. So should you.
meltdown: We're at the bottom of the jar. Don't make me get the slipper.
Any second now and we're throttled. WRAP. IT. UP.
_comment_phase2: Triggers below are for Phase 2 screens (Decision Briefs, Ledger, Project Switcher). Phase 1's statusline never selects them, so {{placeholders}} are inert until the app substitutes them. Placeholders: {{agent}}, {{day}}, {{tokens}}, {{project}}.
brief_queue_empty: Nothing on my desk. Suspiciously quiet.
No briefs waiting. Either you're caught up or you're hiding something.
An empty queue. I'll believe it when it lasts.
brief_piling: Three briefs stacked up. They're not wine — they don't improve with age.
A pile of briefs and not one decision. Pick one, dear.
The queue's backing up. I didn't raise a ditherer.
brief_stale: That top one has sat SIX HOURS. Decide, for pity's sake.
Six hours a brief's been waiting. I've made whole dinners in less.
Still no answer on that old brief? It's practically fossilized.
history_quiet: A quiet week, for once. I almost approve.
Barely a flicker on the ledger this week. Restraint! Who knew.
Light week. Don't let it go to your head.
history_spike: {{day}} was a bonfire — {{tokens}} in one day. What were you building?
{{tokens}} on {{day}} alone. I felt that one in my purse.
{{day}} went up in smoke: {{tokens}}. We'll be discussing that.
history_topagent: {{agent}} ate the most this week — {{tokens}}. We need to talk.
project_switch: Oh, we're worrying about {{project}} now, are we?
Switching to {{project}}. Try to finish one before starting another.
{{project}} it is. I'll keep an eye on the rest while you wander off.
project_idle: {{project}} hasn't stirred in ages. Did we forget about it?
Nothing happening over in {{project}}. Gathering dust.
{{project}} is asleep. Like everyone in this house after 9.
